correctness.rationale: For arbitrary distinct primes p>=3, q and k>=2, the cyclotomic quotient modulo 1-zeta_(q^k) forbids a vanishing sum of p q^k-roots, and field-degree p-1 makes Phi_p the unique relation over Q(zeta_(q^k)). These give exact Fourier zeros for any p-transversal, force all spectral p-sets to be transversals, and yield pairwise orthogonality iff the q-adic depths sum to k or more. Counting the independent graph lifts proves each exact multiplicity, layer cardinality and total. Exact-integer cyclotomic remainder tests from packaged CHECK.py corroborate finite cases and are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural spectral-pair compatibility and enumeration problem for prime-cardinality sets in p q^k cyclic groups. The sharp depth threshold yields k+1 genuinely populated multiplicity strata, exact number of perfect Fourier bases for each set, and the whole incidence total. These quantitative differences are not supplied by a spectrality/tiling existence theorem and are useful for designing distinct orthogonal sampling bases.
